title: Bands he played in: Excelsior, Bloom, Robichaux, Moret, Independent
summary: Picou runs through bands including Manuel Perez's Excelsior, Joe Bloom's orchestra, sixteen years with Robichaux, George Moret, Duconge, and his own Golden Leaf and Independent bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Rika was trying to get A La Ba for him, but he was too late. Mm-hmm. He was too late. Who was it? Rika? Rika. Rikard Alexis, huh? Oh. Rikard Alexis. Oh, I see. I was going to ask about a few of the other old bands that you played with, to check some of those on a list here. Did you ever play with the Excelsior brass? Oh, no. The Excelsior and the Onward brass band. Excelsior and the Onward. Who was the leader of the Excelsior when you were there? Manuel Pérez. They only used one clarinet in those days. One clarinet. And that was the E flat. He flat. He flat. He flat. And there is another band here called the Liar Club Symphony Orchestra. Do you remember ever playing with the... Yes. Yes. Yes. The Liar Club. That was Joe Bloom. That was Joe Bloom's orchestra. Orchestra. That was a symphony orchestra. That's right. And what did, did Bloom play any instrument? Did he just conduct? No. Flute. Flute. Flute. And another band, did you ever play with Robichaux, if you remember? Oh, no. No. I played with Robichaux for 16 long years. 16 years. John Robichaux? No, no, no. And there is another band, George Moret. Or Moret, how do you pronounce it?
Moret. Yes. That was his first band, wasn't it?
One of the best sharp play we had in New Orleans. He used to hit a high note in a parade because he had way up above. He was Carlos Tower. Talk about that? Yes, indeed.
Is that the same George Moret who hired you off Governor Nichol Street for your first job?

Yes. Yes. And another man, Oscar Duconge, D-U-C-O-N-G-E is the way I have his spell. Duconge? Duconge. Duconge. Yes. Duconge. Yes. What kind of a band did he have? Well, he had a good affair band. What did he play? Duconge used to play, let me see, I can't remember that. Cornet. Cornet. The brass band wasn't it? Yes. When you had your own band, when you were the leader, what name did you call that? If you were the leader of the band, when did you, in the old days, did you have a name for the band? No, I know. Are you just... Yes. Like say, for instance, some of them had the imperial band, and that was Manuel Perez's band, wasn't it? The imperial band. Yes. Did you ever have a band of your own that you were the leader that you would give it any certain name? Yes. Let me see if I can remember that name. The Golden Leaf. Golden Leaf. Golden Leaf. Golden Leaf. Oh my God. It was your band. Was there a band called the Independent Band? Yes. That was your band too, Independent. Yes, that was the first band I played in. That was the first one. Yes. Bubu Fortune, like I was telling you. Yes. What was his last name? Bubu Fortune. Fortuny. Fortuny. Fortuny. He was a Bob. He was a fellow about that high. Looked like a Mexican. Yes.
